items.Sentence: The headworks consist of two micro screens, a Parshall flume, and weirs for flow control and distribution.
The headworks consist of two micro screens, a Parshall flume, a grit chamber...

The Facility also has the option to utilize Chemically-Enhanced Primary Treatment (CEPT)... The CEPT uses a coagulant (ferric chloride and an anionic emulsion polymer) to enhance flocculation and coagulation during primary clarification.
The Facility also has two DAFT units which may be utilized to thicken primary solids and WAS.
The Facility has three primary digesters and one secondary digester... Biodegradation of organic materials and production of methane gas and carbon dioxide take place in the primary digesters.
After digestion sludge is dewatered by one of the Facility’s two centrifuges.
Dried biosolids are hauled to a landfill.

Each basin... has been configured as the Modified Ludzack Ettinger (MLE) activated sludge process... recycle aerobic effluent back to the anoxic zone for denitrification of ammonia oxidized to nitrate in the aerobic zone.
Secondary effluent flows... to either a cloth-media disk filter system or a conventional deep-bed, dual media filter system.

Chlorine gas is... used to make a concentrated chlorine/water solution to disinfect the filtered secondary effluent... A sulfur dioxide/water solution is injected... for dechlorination near the outfall building.
Influent raw sewage flow that exceeds the operational setpoint is diverted to equalization ponds (Ponds 1A and 1B) by a control valve.
The Facility has 13 ponds used for influent flow equalization, emergency storage, and facultative treatment and/or centrifuge centrate management.
Historically, Ponds 3A, 3B, 5A, and 5B were used as the Facility’s facultative sludge lagoons (FSLs); however upgrades... negated the need of the FSLs for solids stabilization.
